source.title: A Pinch of Gunpowder
source.description:
I just know you're most excited to hear about what I had planned for the gunpowder.

Have you ever heard of Nitro Boosts? Not nitro boots; boosts. If you have, you're a liar, because they haven't been invented. Until now!

I want you to have the honors of trying them out. All you need to do is add in a pinch of gunpowder right here and push the button. If you want to go even faster, add in a bit more!

Make sure to traverse a variety of terrain before you return.
source.progress: I've already started the clock, why are you still here?
source.completion:
Nice! You made it back in one piece and with minimal burns. I think we can both agree this trial run was a success, in fact I think we can improve this with even more gunpowder!

Thanks for all the data, I knew you wouldn't disappoint. Here's the schematic for your own Nitro Boosts. I insist that you keep your gunpowder usage on the low side, else I'd have competition.
